project: 816 Web to Processing — Six State Grammar

states.name: ROUTE
states.behavior: pulses travel through stable routes; each lane has a distinct speed and direction

states.name: FIELD
states.behavior: four layers drift with different amplitude, phase and vertical range; input adds local buoyancy
states.input: local lift and spread, then slow settle

states.name: ORBIT
states.behavior: rings rotate at related speeds; input changes phase, radius and orbital energy without moving the center

states.name: REWIND
states.behavior: key event creates a large glyph, brief stretch, then reverse traces return toward its origin

states.name: CELLS
states.identity: indexed grid with different row and column grammar
states.behavior: rows use distinct shapes; columns use distinct timing; activated cells create visible phrases
states.input: cell activation plus weak neighbor response

states.name: PARTITION
states.behavior: input opens, closes, fills or shifts large partitions; dividers settle into a new composition
